title: Authorization Receipt v0.2
description: An exactly scoped inner authorization receipt. Proof Surface validates structure and one proposed action. External signature trust, nonce uniqueness, revocation state, and atomic action consumption are separate obligations.

nonce.description: Lowercase hexadecimal representation of at least 128 bits. Randomness and uniqueness are enforced by the producer and consuming store.

$comment: The reference validator also rejects forbidden authorization-suppression field names recursively and requires expires_at to be after issued_at.
